sections.heading: Alma vs Headway: Overview
sections.content: Alma and Headway are the two most popular insurance credentialing and billing platforms for mental health therapists. Alma operates on a subscription model ($95-125/month) with higher reimbursement rates and full practice management tools including AI-powered notes. Headway is completely free to join, has the largest provider network (70,000+), and offers unique clawback protection. In January 2026, Spring Health acquired Alma.

sections.heading: Pricing & ROI Analysis
sections.content: Headway is free while Alma costs $95/month (annual) or $125/month (monthly). However, Alma often negotiates $10-30 higher reimbursement rates per session. At 20 sessions per week with just a $10 rate improvement, you'd generate $800/month in additional revenue - more than covering Alma's membership fee. For high-volume practices, Alma may deliver better net income despite the cost.

sections.heading: Key Feature Differences
sections.content: Alma provides a full practice platform with EHR, AI-powered Note Assist for session documentation, assessment tools, treatment plans, and peer consultation groups with celebrity clinical advisors like Esther Perel and Lori Gottlieb. Headway focuses purely on credentialing and billing - you'll need your own EHR. Headway's unique value is clawback protection: you get paid even if claims are denied, charges disputed, or clients don't pay.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Your decision depends on practice volume and tool preferences:

recommendations.when: You see 20+ sessions/week and want all-in-one tools (EHR, AI notes, community). The higher rates offset membership costs.
You're budget-conscious, prefer using your own EHR, or want the security of clawback protection.
You're a new therapist building your caseload and can't yet justify monthly fees.
You value community features like peer consultation and CE resources.

faqs.q: Is Alma worth it compared to free Headway?
faqs.a: For therapists seeing 20+ sessions/week, yes. Alma's $10-30/session higher reimbursement rates can generate $800+/month in additional revenue, more than covering the $95-125/month membership. The included EHR and AI notes also replace costs of other tools.

faqs.q: Which pays faster - Alma or Headway?
faqs.a: Alma pays weekly while Headway pays bi-weekly (on the 15th and last day of each month). If cash flow timing matters, Alma has an advantage.

faqs.q: Can I use both Alma and Headway?
faqs.a: Generally no - you should not be credentialed with the same payer through both platforms simultaneously as this can create billing conflicts and duplicate credentials.

Headway guarantees payment for care delivered, protecting providers even if claims are denied, charges are disputed, or clients don't pay after sessions. Alma does not advertise equivalent protection.
